summary: IsoEnergy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 8, 2026, reporting completion of summer drilling at the Larocque East project in Canada. The release discloses drill results along the Hurricane South Trend, including radioactivity intervals and uranium geochemistry highlights. No transaction, strategic corporate action, or special situation is involved; it is a routine operational update by the issuer. The registrant is not acting as acquirer, target, seller, or issuer in a deal. Filed pursuant to Rule 13a-16, this is a standard foreign private issuer report with no deal terms, board actions, or advisors mentioned.
